recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s album cover featuring a central glowing white lightbulb hanging by a black cord against a heavily textured, blue-tinted wooden background. The composition is split by the vertical cord, with bold, stylized serif typography flanking the upper half in black and pale yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical cord bisects the frame and separates the two main text blocks.
The bright white of the bulb provides the primary focal point against the dark blue wood.
The organic texture of the wood contrasts with the sharp, geometric swashes of the lettering.
Color blocking uses a triad of cyan-blue, stark black, and pale lemon yellow.
coreInvariants: A single, unshaded white lightbulb as the central icon.
A background of vertical wood grain with a cool blue/teal color cast.
Heavyweight serif typography with pronounced decorative swashes.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The lightbulb is centered horizontally and positioned in the lower-middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing white bulb acts as the anchor, drawing the eye to the center before moving upward to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bulb, follows the cord upward, then reads the left text block (black) followed by the right text block (yellow).
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the area surrounding the bulb are kept relatively clear to emphasize the texture and type.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black (primary text and electrical cord).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale lemon yellow (secondary text) and pure white (bulb).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white bulb and dark background; low saturation across the blue and yellow tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm reds or oranges except for small logo elements.
Maintain a cool-toned, slightly aged photographic look.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight contrast between thick stems and thin hairlines.
Large, circular swashes on terminals (especially 'T', 'K', and 'L').
Tight letter spacing with occasional overlaps.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders or ascenders that curl into decorative loops.
Ball terminals replaced with large, sweeping hooks.

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified relative to the cord

composition.position: Upper half, flanking the central cord

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy using black for the primary name and yellow for the title, both using the same font family.
graphicDevices: Vertical line (cord) as a layout divider
Small rectangular logo box in the upper left

preserve: The high contrast of the strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the era's decorative serif style.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A vertical photograph of a weathered wooden plank wall with a cool blue-cyan tint. A single white frosted lightbulb hangs from a black cord in the center foreground. High contrast, grainy film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of large uppercase text in a heavy swash serif font. The left block is black; the right block is pale yellow. Align the text to the central cord.

verificationChecks: Is the lightbulb the brightest point in the image?
Does the text feature large decorative curls on the letters?
Is the background wood distinctly blue-toned?
Is the composition split vertically by the cord?

adjustableVariables: Degree of swash decoration on the font
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black cord is a continuous line from top to bulb.
Check that the yellow text is legible against the blue background.
Verify the 'STEREO' text is small and centered at the very top.
Confirm the wood texture looks like macro-photography, not a pattern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a macro-textured monochromatic background with a central everyday object, then flank the object's vertical axis with heavy, high-contrast swash typography in two contrasting flat colors.
